func:
// Consulta múltiple a la DB
// msg1: Consulta datos actuales
// msg2: Valores máximos
// msg3: Consulta lluvia acumulada últimas 2h, día, semana y mes
// msg4: barometer, temp, heatindex, windchill, dewpoint últimas 24h

let msg1 = { 

    etiqueta: "msg1",
    topic: "SELECT * FROM archive ORDER BY dateTime DESC LIMIT 1" };

let msg2 = { // Consultas múltiples

    etiqueta: "msg2",
    topic: `SELECT

            -- Fecha actual
            (SELECT dateTime
            FROM archive
            ORDER BY dateTime DESC
            LIMIT 1) AS fecha,

            -- Última lluvia detectada
            (SELECT dateTime
            FROM archive
            WHERE rain > 0
            ORDER BY dateTime DESC
            LIMIT 1) AS ultimaLluvia,

            -- Temperatura máxima 24h
            (SELECT MAX(outTemp)
            FROM archive
            WHERE dateTime >= (strftime('%s','now') - 86400)) AS tempMax,
            
            -- Humedad máxima 24h
            (SELECT MAX(outHumidity)
            FROM archive
            WHERE dateTime >= (strftime('%s','now') - 86400)) AS humMax,
            
            -- Radiación UV máxima 24h (pendiente)
            (SELECT MAX(UV)
            FROM archive
            WHERE dateTime >= (strftime('%s','now') - 86400)) AS uvMax;      
            `};

let msg3 = {

    etiqueta: "msg3", 
    topic: `SELECT 'Tasa_actual' AS Periodo,
                IFNULL(rainRate, 0) AS Lluvia_total
            FROM archive
            WHERE dateTime = (SELECT MAX(dateTime) FROM archive)

            UNION ALL

            SELECT 'ultimas_dos_h' AS Periodo,
                IFNULL(SUM(rain), 0) AS Lluvia_total
            FROM archive
            WHERE dateTime >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-2 hours')

            UNION ALL
            
            SELECT 'Día' AS Periodo,
                IFNULL(SUM(rain), 0) AS Lluvia_total
            FROM archive
            WHERE dateTime >= strftime('%s', 'now', 'start of day', '+5 hours')

            UNION ALL

            SELECT 'Semana' AS Periodo,
                IFNULL(SUM(sum), 0) AS Lluvia_total
            FROM archive_day_rain
            WHERE dateTime >= strftime('%s', 'now', 'start of day', '+5 hours', '-7 days')

            UNION ALL

            SELECT 'Mes' AS Periodo,
                IFNULL(SUM(sum), 0) AS Lluvia_total
            FROM archive_day_rain
            WHERE dateTime >= strftime('%s', 'now', 'start of month', '+5 hours');
            `}; // Se suman 5 horas debido a que el comando 'start of ...' hace el calculo con UTC-0 y luego se pasa a hora local dando 5 horas menos de las que son

let msg4 = {

    etiqueta: "msg4", 
    topic:  `SELECT 
                datetime(dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS periodo,
                barometer,
                outTemp,
                appTemp,
                heatindex,
                dewpoint
            FROM archive
            WHERE dateTime >= (strftime('%s', 'now') - 86400)
            ORDER BY dateTime ASC;
            `};

return [[msg1, msg2, msg3, msg4]]; 
// Al ponerlos dentro de un array doble, Node-RED envía los dos mensajes uno tras otro

func:
let rango = msg.rango;

if (rango == 1){
    msg.topic = `SELECT 
                    datetime(dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS periodo,
                    outTemp AS outTemp,
                    inTemp AS inTemp,
                    outHumidity AS outHumidity,
                    inHumidity AS inHumidity,
                    dewpoint AS dewpoint,
                    barometer AS pressure,
                    rainRate AS rainRate,
                    heatindex AS heatindex,
                    windchill AS windchill,
                    windSpeed AS windSpeed,
                    windDir AS windDir
                FROM archive 
                WHERE date(dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') BETWEEN '${msg.payload.fecha1}' AND '${msg.payload.fecha2}'
                ORDER BY periodo ASC;`;

} else if (rango == 2){
    msg.topic = `SELECT 
                    strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS periodo,
                    AVG(outTemp) AS outTemp,
                    AVG(inTemp) AS inTemp,
                    AVG(outHumidity) AS outHumidity,
                    AVG(inHumidity) AS inHumidity,
                    AVG(dewpoint) AS dewpoint,
                    AVG(pressure) AS pressure,
                    AVG(rainRate) AS rainRate,
                    AVG(heatindex) AS heatindex,
                    AVG(windchill) AS windchill,
                    AVG(windSpeed) AS windSpeed,
                    AVG(windDir) AS windDir
                FROM archive 
                WHERE date(dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') BETWEEN '${msg.payload.fecha1}' AND '${msg.payload.fecha2}'
                GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')
                ORDER BY periodo ASC;`;

}else{
    msg.topic = `SELECT 
                    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS periodo,
                    AVG(outTemp) AS outTemp,
                    AVG(inTemp) AS inTemp,
                    AVG(outHumidity) AS outHumidity,
                    AVG(inHumidity) AS inHumidity,
                    AVG(dewpoint) AS dewpoint,
                    AVG(pressure) AS pressure,
                    AVG(rainRate) AS rainRate,
                    AVG(heatindex) AS heatindex,
                    AVG(windchill) AS windchill,
                    AVG(windSpeed) AS windSpeed,
                    AVG(windDir) AS windDir
                FROM archive 
                WHERE date(dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') BETWEEN '${msg.payload.fecha1}' AND '${msg.payload.fecha2}'
                GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d', dateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')
                ORDER BY periodo ASC;`;
}
return msg;
